priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore listener removal in the returned disposer
findings.body: After callers invoke the disposer while the socket remains active, the handler still receives messages and its closure remains retained. Repeated attach/dispose cycles accumulate listeners, duplicate side effects, increase memory use, and can trigger EventEmitter listener-limit warnings.

findings.title: [P1] Clear the interval when polling is disposed
findings.body: Invoking the returned disposer no longer stops polling. The timer retains `refresh` and executes it every second indefinitely; repeated start/dispose cycles accumulate timers and work, and in Node.js the referenced interval can prevent process shutdown.

findings.title: [P1] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts lines 2-3 still register the message handler with socket.on and return a no-op disposer. The full diff confirms this PR replaced socket.off("message", handler), so disposal retains and continues invoking the listener.
